# Thought Escape

> Thought Escape is a meditative mobile puzzle game where you tap tiles to escape them off a shaped board across four themed worlds: Ocean, Mountain, Forest, and Snow.

## What it is

Thought Escape is a calm, puzzle-focused mobile game built around the metaphor of clearing thoughts from your mind. Players tap arrow tiles on a shaped board to "escape" them off the edges, working through dependencies and escape chains. Each level is rendered as a themed gemstone relic from one of four worlds.

## Platforms

- iOS — available now
- Android — coming alongside iOS launch

## Core capabilities

- Hand-tuned campaign levels plus an infinite procedurally generated pool
- 5 adaptive difficulty tiers — easy, medium, hard, expert, nightmare
- 4 themed worlds — Ocean (moon pearls), Mountain (sun runes), Forest (spirit seeds), Snow (aurora shards)
- 16 tile mechanics — frozen tiles, walls, gates, gravity, mirrors, portals, countdown, splitters, fire cells, blind tiles, charged tiles, growing blockers, heavy tiles, loops, sacrifice, linked
- 11 power-up tools — undo, rotate, magnet, drill, dynamite, ghost, swap, mirror drop, portal drop, freeze, hint
- 11 board shapes including a 9×9 fortress, labyrinth, and mega-octagon
- Daily procedurally generated puzzle, themed to your current world
- Streak system with milestone reward chests at day 7, 14, 20, 30, 60, 90, and 180
- Tool mastery — earn mastery tokens from hard clears to permanently increase a tool's daily free uses
- Cosmetic board skins — 12 skins, $0.99–$1.99 each, plus a bundle
- Leaderboard with anonymous usernames

## What Thought Escape is not

- Not a slot machine. No daily free-spin wheels, no gacha loot.
- Not a timer-driven game. Campaign levels have no countdown unless the mechanic explicitly requires one.
- Not an ad farm. No forced interstitials. Rewarded ads are optional. A $4.99 one-time upgrade removes all ads forever.
- Not Candy Crush. Built for calm, not for urgency.

## Pricing

Free to download. Optional in-app purchases:

- Starter Bundle — $0.99 one-time (300 shards + 10 world currency for your current world; offered once on first launch)
- Shard packs — $1.99 to $14.99
- World currency packs — $0.99 (Quick Boost, +50 for current world), $2.99 (All-World Pack, +40 of every world currency), $6.99 (Power Player, +120 of every world currency + 3 Dynamite tokens)
- Extra moves — $0.99 consumable (+5 moves for the current level)
- Restore lives — $0.99 consumable
- Remove Ads — subscription: $4.99/month, $9.99/quarter, $29.99/year; or $49.99 lifetime one-time purchase
- Board skins — $0.99 to $1.99 each, or $4.99 for the full bundle

None of these gate progression.

## FAQs

**What is Thought Escape?**
A meditative mobile puzzle game. Tap arrow tiles on a shaped board to escape them off the edges. Hand-tuned levels plus an infinite procedural pool across four themed worlds.

**What platforms does it run on?**
Available on iOS. Android coming soon.

**Is it free to play?**
Yes. Optional in-app purchases include shards, world currency packs, cosmetic board skins, and a Remove Ads subscription ($4.99/month or $49.99 lifetime). None gate progression.

**How is it different from other tile puzzles?**
Built for calm rather than urgency. No timers on standard levels, no forced ads mid-play, no gacha mechanics. Cosmetic spend, never pay-to-win.

**What are the four worlds?**
Ocean (moon pearls), Mountain (sun runes), Forest (spirit seeds), Snow (aurora shards). Each has its own art, tile materials, sounds, and currency.

**Who builds Thought Escape?**
Solo built by Ananya Banerjee.
